SELECT status, count(*) orders, sum(CASE WHEN dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_dispatch, min(order_ts_utc), max(order_ts_utc)
FROM fact_web_order WHERE order_ts_utc >= '2025-11-20' AND order_ts_utc < '2025-12-12' GROUP BY 1

WITH campaign AS (SELECT start_date, end_date + 7 AS window_end FROM dim_campaign WHERE campaign_id = 15),
targeted AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id = 15),
holdout AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id = 15),
members AS (SELECT member_id, 'targeted' g FROM targeted UNION ALL SELECT member_id, 'holdout' FROM holdout),
lines AS (
  SELECT m.member_id, f.net_amount, s.store_id, f.receipt_id, f.sale_date,
         w.status, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', w.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
dated AS (
  SELECT l.*, CASE WHEN l.store_id = 900 THEN l.dispatch_date ELSE l.sale_date END AS recog_date
  FROM lines l
  WHERE NOT (l.store_id = 900 AND (l.status IS NULL OR l.status NOT IN ('delivered','collected')))
),
ms AS (SELECT d.member_id, SUM(d.net_amount) ns FROM dated d, campaign c WHERE d.recog_date BETWEEN c.start_date AND c.window_end GROUP BY 1)
SELECT mb.g, count(*) members, round(avg(coalesce(ms.ns,0)),4) mean_net, round(sum(coalesce(ms.ns,0)),2) tot, count(ms.ns) buyers
FROM members mb LEFT JOIN ms USING(member_id) GROUP BY 1

WITH params AS (SELECT 15 AS campaign_id),
campaign AS (SELECT c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name, c.start_date, c.end_date + 7 AS window_end FROM dim_campaign c JOIN params ON params.campaign_id = c.campaign_id),
targeted AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key JOIN params ON params.campaign_id = e.campaign_id),
holdout AS (SELECT DISTINCT h.member_id FROM campaign_holdout h JOIN params ON params.campaign_id = h.campaign_id),
members AS (SELECT member_id, 'targeted' AS member_group FROM targeted UNION ALL SELECT member_id, 'holdout' FROM holdout),
web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')),
member_sales AS (
    SELECT m.member_id, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_member m  ON m.member_key = f.member_key
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    CROSS JOIN campaign
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) BETWEEN campaign.start_date AND campaign.window_end
    GROUP BY 1),
by_group AS (SELECT mb.member_group, COUNT(*) AS members, AVG(COALESCE(ms.net_sales, 0)) AS mean_net_sales FROM members mb LEFT JOIN member_sales ms ON ms.member_id = mb.member_id GROUP BY 1)
SELECT member_group, members, mean_net_sales FROM by_group

SELECT s.store_id, f.channel_code, f.staff_purchase_flag, count(*) n, round(sum(f.net_amount),2) net, round(max(f.net_amount),2) mx, sum(CASE WHEN f.net_amount<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) neg, sum(CASE WHEN f.quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.member_key IS NOT NULL AND f.sale_date BETWEEN '2025-11-24' AND '2025-12-07' AND s.store_id IN (900,999) OR (f.member_key IS NOT NULL AND f.sale_date BETWEEN '2025-11-24' AND '2025-12-07' AND f.staff_purchase_flag)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH campaign AS (SELECT campaign_id, campaign_name, start_date, end_date + 7 AS window_end FROM dim_campaign WHERE campaign_id = 15),
targeted AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id = 15),
holdout AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id = 15),
members AS (SELECT member_id, 'targeted' AS grp FROM targeted UNION ALL SELECT member_id, 'holdout' FROM holdout),
member_sales AS (
  SELECT m.member_id, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  CROSS JOIN campaign c
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND (s.store_id <> 900 OR w.status IN ('delivered','collected'))
    AND CASE WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', w.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) ELSE f.sale_date END BETWEEN c.start_date AND c.window_end
  GROUP BY 1),
by_group AS (SELECT mb.grp, AVG(COALESCE(ms.net_sales, 0)) AS mean_net FROM members mb LEFT JOIN member_sales ms USING (member_id) GROUP BY 1)
SELECT c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN grp='targeted' THEN mean_net END), 2) AS avg_spend_per_targeted_member,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN grp='holdout' THEN mean_net END), 2) AS avg_spend_per_held_out_member,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN grp='targeted' THEN mean_net END) - MAX(CASE WHEN grp='holdout' THEN mean_net END), 2) AS uplift_eur
FROM by_group CROSS JOIN campaign c GROUP BY c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name
